V-M-API.Scenario: API starts on a migrated database and exposes a healthy deterministic application surface.

V-M-WORKER.Scenario: Worker-visible storage and domain invariants remain covered by repository regression tests.

V-M-DATABASE.Scenario: Transactions, migrations and foreign-key invariants remain valid.

V-M-BACKUP.Scenario: A backup can be created, verified and restored without losing the supported database state.

V-M-MIGRATION-RUNNER.Scenario: HEAD supports clean installation and upgrade from the exact base revision with integrity checks.
A schema change produces a verifiable pre-migration backup that restores the base schema.

V-M-GRACE-GOVERNANCE.Scenario: Governed writes outside an approved ObservedWriteScope fail closed.
Applied migrations cannot be modified, renamed or deleted.

V-M-CI-GATE.Scenario: GRACE merge-gate succeeds only when its contract and database jobs both succeed.

V-M-OFFLINE-BUNDLE.Scenario: Governance changes do not introduce a runtime dependency on Bun or GRACE into the offline bundle.
